sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 168)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American and British radio, Roy Acuff and Minnie Pearl live from the Ryman Auditorium on the *Grand Ole Opry* for Prince Albert Tobacco, Lloyd Nolan as hardboiled detective Martin Kane for Sano Cigarettes, Paul Whiteman celebrating Georgia Gibbs' birthday on the *Philco Radio Hall of Fame*, *The Flying Doctor* in Australia, Gerald Mohr on *Crime Is My Pastime*, and *The Texas Rangers* (1945–1959):
